basic_profile.bio: XtremeGamer42 is a 25-year-old living in Austin, Texas. They work as a junior software developer at a tech startup. In their free time, they enjoy gaming, particularly first-person shooters like Call of Duty. They are also passionate about crochet, which they recently picked up as a hobby. They usually browse Reddit in the evenings after work, and on weekends. XtremeGamer42 is single and often plays games with online friends. They dislike overly negative people and console wars.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: XtremeGamer42 has a background in computer science, having graduated from a local university. They are self-taught in gaming mechanics and enjoy learning through online tutorials and gaming forums. They are also learning crochet through YouTube videos and subreddits dedicated to the craft.
